geopolitics_summary: Middle East conflict and Russian sanctions bill pressure EU energy; Macron convenes emergency G7 on energy prices and hybrid threats.

themes.headline: Macron calls emergency G7 meeting on energy price spike, Russian hybrid attacks
themes.why_it_matters: Signals sustained geopolitical premium on EU power and gas; Russian hybrid attacks on infrastructure risk supply disruptions and upside on DA power spreads and TTF winter curve.

themes.headline: Germany cuts fuel tax as Middle East conflicts drive prices higher
themes.why_it_matters: Middle East conflict threatens crude and refined product supply; fuel tax cut signals government acknowledgment of price shock. Crude volatility feeds into power margins via fuel-switching economics and thermal generation costs.

themes.headline: US House passes Russia sanctions bill, increasing leverage on Moscow
themes.why_it_matters: New US Russia sanctions risk further restriction on Russian energy exports; indirectly tightens LNG market and supports TTF via reduced competition for EU LNG demand, upside bias on winter gas prices.

themes.headline: Corpus Christi LNG Stage 3 now operational, second-largest US facility
themes.why_it_matters: Completion of seventh LNG train increases US export capacity; higher global LNG supply may ease TTF tensions and reduce winter gas curve risk if flows reach NW Europe; downside bias on Cal+1 and Cal+2 gas.

themes.headline: EU to ban metal scrap exports to India and Egypt on environmental grounds
themes.why_it_matters: Trade restrictions on scrap may reduce overseas demand for EU industrial output and lower EU industrial power demand; indirect marginal pressure on power prices via reduced industrial load, minor bearish signal.

watchlist: G7 emergency energy meeting outcome and any coordinated supply/demand policy response
US Russia sanctions bill signed; watch for secondary sanctions targeting energy trade
Corpus Christi LNG Stage 3 ramp-up timeline and first cargoes to Europe; monitor LNG bid-ask spreads
Middle East conflict escalation; oil supply disruption risk and Brent-TTF arb widening
